primary_hypothesis: Finite-precision subtraction of large cumulative decay logs loses an intervening decay in the specified short canary; interval products preserve the sequential core result while retaining the same equations.
primary_comparator: Frozen sequential kron_recurrent on identical synthetic core inputs; source direct/factored paths are explicit controls.
primary_success_rule: Interval-product unscaled core passes frozen output/state/gradient/optimizer mechanics tolerances on every declared core case. Source failures, candidate failures and all secondary scaling arms are retained. A model-row gate is reported separately and can fail without being hidden.

authorization.required_approval: Exact donor approval under AGENTS.md rule 3 before dependency installation or tensor/model execution.
authorization.resources: Existing local CPU, one PyTorch/inter-op/BLAS thread; maximum 600 CPU seconds and 900 wall seconds for the canary, excluding dependency download/install.
authorization.dependencies: Session-local virtual environment only, CPU-only torch==2.9.1+cpu and its required Python dependencies; no global install or GPU packages.
authorization.dependency_size_evidence: Official cp313 x86_64 CPU wheel is 184380800 bytes, SHA256 39b3dff6d8fba240ae0d1bede4ca11c2531ae3b47329206512d99e17907ff74b. This is metadata/HEAD evidence, not a downloaded binary.
authorization.additional_disk_cap: 1 GiB for environment, temporary wheel/install data and canary outputs together; stop if this cannot be met. No corpus or checkpoint downloads.
authorization.artifact_cap: 50 MiB new result/diagnostic artifacts; no full checkpoints saved.
authorization.synthetic_optimizer_steps: At most one AdamW step per candidate/reference pair in the one named model qualification row.

design.source: Hash-pinned parent model.py, common.py, qualify.py, protocol/addenda. No archived file modifications.
design.reference: source sequential recurrence, same visible dtype and input tensors
design.factorial_control: Interval vs prefix and scaled vs unscaled are separated. Primary contrast is interval_direct vs source_direct; combined changes are secondary.

tiny_core_cases.expected_two_token_zero_state: For first gate very negative: final=1/2+exp(-1)/4. Hypothesis: FP32 prefix controls give 3/4 at -2^27 while FP64 retains the increment; -2^56 tests the analogous FP64 limit.

random_core_cases.q_k_v: normalized seeded synthetic values; include zero and 1e-10-scaled value positions
random_core_cases.gates: nonpositive seeded gates and sigmoid beta/write
random_core_cases.reset_and_chunk_checks: nonzero state, before-token resets, irregular split, same-shape future intervention
random_core_cases.derivatives: all independent core input gradients under one fixed scalar probe

checks: one AdamW step and optimizer state
model_row.positive_control: Repeat the source factored/reference row with the archived FP64-core workaround, clearly labeled mixed precision.

tolerances.policy: Use the frozen parent tolerances; no post-hoc relaxation. Capture finite failures and missing gradients.

stop_rules: nonfinite candidate values or unexpected resource requirement: preserve diagnostics and stop that line
next: If mechanics pass, propose a separately approved wider fidelity/performance canary; do not launch training from this result.
